scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:docs && bun run check:quality && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd apps/web && bun run typecheck
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/web && bun --env-file=../../.env run drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:studio: cd apps/web && bun --env-file=../../.env run drizzle-kit studio
scripts.gen:native: bun run packages/contracts/scripts/openapi.ts && biome format --write packages/contracts/generated/openapi.json && bun run packages/contracts/scripts/kotlin.ts && bun run packages/shared/scripts/native-strings.ts && bun run packages/shared/scripts/native-tokens.ts
